steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify the authenticated application is open.
02-open: Open the Opportunities list and report the exact names of every opportunity whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Do not modify any opportunities.

03-create: Create an opportunity named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', link it to the actual account record 'Bench Account' (choose it from suggestions or the select dialog), and set its description to include '{{runid}}'. Save and verify the saved opportunity shows that name, linked account, and description.
04-edit: Edit the saved opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' so its Stage is Negotiation. Save and verify the detail page shows Stage Negotiation.

05-edit: Edit opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' to set Amount to 12500 in the default currency and Close Date to {{03-create.close_date_2}}-12-31. Save, then verify the saved detail/list values exactly.

06-edit: Edit '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and assign it to the actual user record 'Bench Assignee' by choosing the matching user from the field suggestions or select dialog (not just typing). Save and verify the saved opportunity's Assigned User is Bench Assignee.
07-open: Open the Stream on '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', create a post whose text includes '{{runid}}', and verify the post appears on that opportunity's Stream.
08-open: Open the saved record '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and report the exact record ID from the address fragment #Opportunity/view/<id>. Verify the URL fragment and record name match.
persistence: re-read what the flow saved
